BLSPOLY.NS.longBusinessSummary: BLS Polymers Limited manufactures polymer compounds for the wire and cable and industrial pipeline coating industries. The company operates through two segments: Polymer and Trading. The company manufactures polyethylene compounds, including high-density polyethylene, medium-density polyethylene, low-density polyethylene, and linear low-density polyethylene variants, used for insulation, jacketing, and sheathing of power, telecom, and optical fiber cables. It also manufactures cross-linked polyethylene compounds, silane-grafted, for insulation of low-tension and high-tension power cables, including aerial bunched cables. Additionally, the company manufactures halogen-free flame retardant compounds for insulation and jacketing of cables, as well as polyvinyl chloride compounds for insulation and sheathing of power, data, signaling, automotive, and house wiring cables. It also offers cable filling compounds for moisture resistance and insulation in telecom cables, along with specialty additive, black, and white masterbatches for polymer products. For industrial pipeline coating applications, the company manufactures high-density polyethylene top coat compounds for the outer layer of three-layer polyethylene pipeline coating systems used on oil, gas, and water distribution pipelines, and polypropylene top coat compounds for three-layer polypropylene pipeline coating applications. It also manufactures adhesive compounds, which serve as intermediate layer adhesives for bonding between the fusion bonded epoxy base layer and the top coat layer in three-layer pipeline coating systems. Additionally, the company trades polymers and operates as a stockist and distributor of polymer products. BLS Polymers Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in New Delhi, India.

SFCTECH.NS.longBusinessSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited engages in the design, technology, manufacturing, supply and supervision for installation and commissioning of equipment for the treatment of wastewater and solid waste in India and internationally. The company offers Cyclic activated sludge technology (C-Tech), a technology for treating sewage and effluents. The company's C-Tech technology solutions include decanters, diffusers, air blowers, fiber disc filters, solar sludge drying system along with programmable logic controllers, and supervisory control and data acquisition-based automation solutions; and operations and maintenance services, and related accessories. It also provides OREX multi-stage system to separate biodegradable organics from inorganic materials and lignocellulosic fibers from mixed municipal wastes for solid waste treatment plants. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Thane, India.

BCSSL.NS.longBusinessSummary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited processes and manufactures steel coils into processed steel products.
